name: letters-home-instagram-import
description: Guide Instagram JSON exports and selected photo-post imports through the Letters Home website.

interface.longDescription: Guides a focused Instagram JSON export (Posts, or Media with your approval) and selected photo-post review in the signed-in Letters Home website when its importer is available. Optional assistance uses browser and file controls supplied by your host; manual instructions remain available. No Node.js, MCP server, Instagram API connection or account-type change is required. The website receives dates and photo paths for all found posts for duplicate checks; approved captions and photos upload to your chosen collection. Collection sharing settings apply, and browser content may be visible to your AI host.
defaultPrompt: Help me export my Instagram photo posts and import selected posts into my Letters Home collection.
Walk me through importing an Instagram JSON export without accessing my browser.

publication.release_notes: Refine live-tested Meta Account export setup: clear unrelated categories, handle Media-only choices, resume security checks and verify accepted requests. Guide selected-post import and editable placeholder subjects.
